description: This file defines the EmailConfiguration class, which maps to the ohrm_email_configuration database table and includes properties for SMTP settings and email preferences in the OrangeHRM system. It contains getters and setters for each property and is used for configuring email communication within the HRM application.

classes.name: EmailConfiguration
classes.description: Entity class representing email configuration settings in the HRM system, including SMTP server details and email preferences.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the email configuration record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the email configuration record.

methods.name: getMailType
methods.description: Returns the type of mail configuration, if specified.

methods.name: setMailType
methods.description: Sets the type of mail configuration.

methods.name: getSentAs
methods.description: Returns the sender identification used in emails.

methods.name: setSentAs
methods.description: Sets the sender identification used in emails.

methods.name: getSmtpUsername
methods.description: Returns the SMTP username for authentication.

methods.name: setSmtpUsername
methods.description: Sets the SMTP username for authentication.

methods.name: getSmtpPassword
methods.description: Returns the SMTP password for authentication.

methods.name: setSmtpPassword
methods.description: Sets the SMTP password for authentication.
